title: TRACE-lite v1.0 — typed reasoning & commitment record
description: Adapted subset of the TRACE schema (Chang & Chang, arXiv:2607.12480). One JSONL line per entry in .claude/memory/trace/records.jsonl: kind=record (an adjudicated claim) or kind=action (a consumer decision appended against a record). Records are immutable; corrections are new records that `revises` the old one. Policy (verdict semantics, evidence standard per claim type, consumer action matrix) lives in .claude/memory/topics/trace.md. Only the JSON-Schema keywords supported by scripts/trace/lib.mjs may be used here (a unit test enforces this).

kind.description: file_line = a path[:line]; command = a command run + its output; browser = a localhost observation; measurement = a number vs a declared bar (axe, bundle); rule = the named rule/standard a claim invokes; diff = the real patch; reading = code reading without a reproducible pointer (never sufficient for accept); record = a prior TRACE record; human = a human decision.

writer_id.description: who wrote the verdict, e.g. critic-panel/verify:qa-e2e-3, loop-iteration/verify:LP-002-0, lead, dream

claim_id.description: stable fingerprint shared by every revision of the same claim

subject.description: what the claim is about: a file, a story id, a plan node id, a wiki page

counter_reasons.description: refutation attempts / defeaters the checker considered

missing.description: the evidence that would tighten, flip, or justify the claim — required non-empty for defer

repair.description: the bounded fix or restated claim — required for revise

qualifier.description: the reduced strength the claim holds at — required for qualify

tree.description: working-tree fingerprint (pnpm trace tree-id): HEAD + uncommitted changes; equal ids mean identical code
